title: Our Logo
slide_intent: Teach a designer what the primary mark already communicates. That helps avoid repeating affiliations or crowding its silhouette.
strategic_value: The MIT initials built into the graphic can tell viewers the lab’s affiliation in a single signature.
demonstration: A single large mark occupies the center of a pale panel. The left text explains the separate decisions about a lab descriptor, the available variants and mark placement.
practical_value: Check whether the primary mark alone identifies the lab or whether the expanded name would help the audience.

content_islands.name: Usage guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and explanation in the left rail. Discuss choosing the artwork for its size, setting and composition.

content_islands.name: Primary mark
content_islands.spec: Center the color mark in a large pale field and keep generous clear space around it.
